meta.name: EXIMMAN
meta.tagline: MANAGE YOUR IMPORT AND EXPORT AT THE PALM OF YOUR HAND !!
meta.description: A comprehensive Ethiopian Import/Export trade-operations management platform. EXIMMAN unifies Letters of Credit, import shipment tracking, customs tax estimation, inventory, an export pipeline (local sourcing, Cash-Against-Documents, export shipments), a full finance ledger (expenses, petty cash, payables, receivables), multi-bank FX rates, AI insights, and an executive reporting archive — tailored for Ethiopian Birr (ETB) trade through the Djibouti–Modjo–Addis corridor.
meta.domain: International trade operations (import/export) for the Ethiopian market
meta.primaryUser: CEO / operations managers of an Ethiopian import-export trading company (e.g. Midas Global Trade Ltd)

brandMark.subtitle: EXPORT • IMPORT • MANAGER
brandMark.graphic: Globe + shipping box motif in heritage brown

frontend.framework: React (Vite, no React import needed — JSX auto-transform)
frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS with CSS custom properties (H S% L% format, no hsl() wrapper)
frontend.theming: Light/dark mode via ThemeProvider (class strategy, localStorage sync)

backend.storage: In-memory storage (MemStorage) implementing an IStorage interface
backend.ai: OpenAI GPT-4o-mini via Replit AI Integrations

shared.schema: shared/schema.ts (Drizzle pgTable definitions + drizzle-zod insert schemas + inferred types)

techStack.serving: Single Express server serves both API and Vite frontend on one port (npm run dev)
constraints: Do NOT modify vite.config.ts, server/vite.ts, drizzle.config.ts, or package.json
Keep routes thin — all CRUD goes through the storage interface
Validate request bodies with Zod before touching storage
Add data-testid to every interactive and meaningful display element

designSystem.concept: Ethiopian heritage trade ledger — warm brown/peach earth tones evoking coffee, leather-bound trade books, and the Ethiopian highlands, paired with a clean operational data layer.
designSystem.containerStrategy: Shadcn Card surfaces with subtle elevation; consistent small/medium/large spacing scale

palette.format: H S% L% (space-separated, percentages on S and L, not wrapped in hsl())

ethiopianContext.currency: ETB (Ethiopian Birr); FX quoted as USD/ETB, sourced from the Addis Fortune exchange board
ethiopianContext.importRoute: Supplier → Port of Loading → Sea → Djibouti → Modjo → Warehouse
ethiopianContext.exportRoute: Local supplier → Warehouse → Inland transport → Djibouti port → Destination country

taxModel.lcOpening: Margin 30%, bank commission 4%, VAT 15%, Swift charge

pages.name: Landing
pages.description: Marketing landing page with sticky nav (EXIMMAN logo), hero, features, about, contact, theme toggle.

pages.name: SignIn
pages.description: Sign-in screen with EXIMMAN logo header; sets a local session and routes into the app.

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Executive overview: KPI stat cards (total shipments, active LCs, customs at risk, revenue/inventory value), monthly trade-volume trend chart, multi-bank live ETB FX panel, recent shipments, AI intelligent insights, Generate Report action.

pages.name: AI Insights
pages.description: AI engine: efficiency score gauge, trade predictions, risk detection, and an AI chat assistant backed by GPT-4o-mini.

pages.name: Finance
pages.description: Financial ledger: expenses, petty cash accounts & transactions, accounts payable (supplier payments), accounts receivable (customer payments), balances and cash-flow.

pages.name: Exchange Rates
pages.description: Addis Fortune exchange board across Ethiopian banks with buying/selling and cash buying/selling ETB rates plus a USD/ETB converter.

pages.name: LC Management
pages.description: Full CRUD for Letters of Credit with an auto-calculated cost-breakdown modal (opening payments advice + settlement amount), paid/unpaid status indicators.

pages.name: Import Shipments
pages.description: Import shipment tracking along the Djibouti–Modjo–warehouse route, documents, customs financials, pre-fill from an approved LC.

pages.name: Inventory
pages.description: Post-clearance stock with warehouse utilization, low-stock alerts, sale pricing, booking, and AI stock forecasting.

pages.name: Export Purchases
pages.description: Local sourcing of export goods from Ethiopian suppliers: product, grade, quantity (kg), cost, warehouse, certifications, payment status.

pages.name: CAD Management
pages.description: Cash-Against-Documents export instruments: buyer & bank details, FOB/freight/insurance, contract value, exchange rate, bank commission, NBE retention, documents required.

pages.name: Export Shipments
pages.description: Outbound export shipments: vessel, container, BL, declaration, route to destination country, costs in ETB/USD, documents & certifications.

pages.name: Customs Engine
pages.description: Real-time customs tax calculator (CIF, duty, surtax, VAT, withholding), required-documents status, and AI HS-code classification.

pages.name: Settings
pages.description: Company profile, bank accounts, suppliers, foreign buyers, certifications, and notification preferences with toggles.

navigation.shell: Shadcn Sidebar (collapsible, 15rem / 3.5rem icon) + top header with sidebar trigger, global search, notifications bell, theme toggle, and user menu with sign-out.

aiFeatures.model: OpenAI GPT-4o-mini via Replit AI Integrations
capabilities: AI chat assistant (trade questions, operational guidance)
Executive report generation (period-based, Detailed/Precise modes with charts)
Risk detection and trade predictions on the AI Insights page
HS-code classification suggestions in the Customs Engine

order: 1. Define the full data model in shared/schema.ts (Drizzle pgTable + drizzle-zod insert schemas + inferred types) before any other code.
2. Implement IStorage and MemStorage in server/storage.ts covering CRUD for every model, typed with @shared/schema.
3. Write thin Express routes in server/routes.ts that validate with Zod and delegate to storage.
4. Build the frontend shell: ThemeProvider, Shadcn Sidebar nav, top header, wouter routing in client/src/App.tsx.
5. Implement each page under client/src/pages using TanStack Query (object form), Shadcn Form + zodResolver for inputs, and Recharts for charts.
6. Apply the heritage brown/peach palette via CSS variables in index.css (H S% L% format) and wire light/dark modes.
7. Wire AI features (chat, report generation, HS-code, forecasting) through /api/ai and /api/reports using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini.
8. Brand the app: EXIMMAN logo in sidebar, sign-in, and landing nav; favicon; HTML title and meta description.
conventions: Add data-testid to every interactive and meaningful display element.
Use @/ for shadcn components/hooks and @assets/ for attached assets.
Currency display: ETB primary, USD where contractually relevant; numeric figures in mono font.
No emojis anywhere — use lucide-react icons instead.
Keep files modular; reuse Shadcn Card/Button/Badge rather than custom equivalents.
